scheme_name: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund For Sportspersons
other_conditions: Must be a sportsperson of yesteryears who has retired from active sports

Must have won medals in individual or team events in National Games and National Championships (Senior category) recognized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, or must have participated in International sports events such as Olympic Games, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, etc., in senior category
Must be living in indigent circumstances (or be a family member of a deceased sportsperson/support personnel living in indigent circumstances)
For injury assistance, the sportsperson must have sustained injuries during training or participation in sports competitions, including Sub‑Junior and Junior category events

For training/equipment assistance, the sportsperson’s parents must be living in indigent circumstances; sportspersons from federations that are de‑recognised, suspended, or not yet recognised are also eligible

Coaches and support personnel (sports doctors, psychologists, mentors, physiotherapists, masseurs, umpires, referees, match officials) attached to national coaching camps or associated with recognized senior national/international events and living in indigent circumstances are eligible
Applicants must disclose any assistance received from other sources for the same purpose
benefits_summary: Provides lump‑sum financial assistance (up to Rs. 5‑10 lakh) and a monthly pension of Rs. 5,000 for retired meritorious sportspersons in indigent conditions, as well as assistance for injuries, families of deceased sportspersons, medical treatment, and coaches/support personnel.
application_link: Member - Secretary, Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund for Sportspersons (PDUNWFS), Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Shastri Bhawan, New Delhi - 110001
